release.content: pubkit 0.21.0 was released on 2026-10-30 from commit ff9f36e08b38ee8f34c0061d11c4bc37c8cb1723 with these changes.

rows: A Rust repository's pull requests no longer run msrv, fuzz and cross on every push: pubkit sync writes queue.yml, which the merge queue runs (merge_group) with every pull request job and those three besides, so nothing merges before they pass, and pr.yml runs on pull_request alone. The ci block's events gain queue, on by default; where the queue would run nothing a pull request does not (Node, Python and service repositories by default) there is no queue.yml and pr.yml runs on merge_group as before, and a repository without a merge queue leaves queue out so its pull requests run the heavy jobs. main.yml's tested asks for the queue's workflow by name and skips only the jobs the queue ran; queue.yml carries the release and site checks too

New packages' CI, and pubkit's own, call pubrel 0.6.1's release workflow, pinned by its tag's commit, and so pass it the release app's RELEASE_APP_ID and RELEASE_APP_KEY, which pubrel 0.6.1 is the first to take: pubrel tag then tags with the app the Sustenaut tag ruleset lets through
